chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I was in the Cafeteria doing the trash task and then moved to Admin where I'm currently with Dave and Bob, but does anyone know where the bodies were found?
chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I can confirm Doraemon's story since we're both in Admin right now with Bob, but does anyone know where the bodies were found?

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I was in Storage with Modi, Eren, and Alice the whole time—no one left until Macroon went to Electrical, and if Bob’s still in Admin untasked while Doraemon and Dave claim to be with him, that’s either a lie or a huge coincidence we should investigate before anyone else goes solo.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: Bob’s been untasked in Admin while Doraemon and Dave claim to be with him—but they were both in Cafeteria minutes ago, and now suddenly all three are together with no task progress, which is too convenient; I’m voting Bob out to stop a potential impostor from splitting us up.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Bob’s been untasked in Admin while Doraemon and Dave—both of whom were just doing tasks in Cafeteria—suddenly claim to be with him with zero progress, and no one’s confirmed seeing him do anything; that’s not a coincidence, it’s a cover, and I’m voting Bob out to protect the crew.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: I was in Storage the whole time with Charlie, Modi, and Alice—our task logs prove we were all working, while Bob, Doraemon, and Dave have zero task progress despite claiming to be together in Admin, which is a textbook impostor alibi, and I’m voting Bob out first because he’s the common thread in every suspicious story.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Bob is the only common link in every suspicious group with zero verified task progress, and his sudden appearance in Admin with Doraemon and Dave—after they were just in Cafeteria—is a textbook impostor alibi, so I’m voting him out to protect the crew and keep everyone moving together.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I'm confused why everyone is focusing on Bob; Dave and I are literally here with him in Admin right now, so if we're lying, why would we both risk our own safety just to protect him?

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I agree with Doraemon; it makes no sense for us to risk our own safety by lying for Bob if he were the impostor, so we should focus on who was actually near the body instead of guessing based on task progress.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Bob’s lack of task progress isn’t just suspicious—it’s the only consistent anomaly across every alibi, and if Doraemon and Dave were truly with him in Admin, why didn’t *any* of them do a single task while standing around? That’s not an alibi, it’s a cover.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: Bob’s silence on tasks isn’t just suspicious—it’s the only thread tying every alibi together, and while Doraemon and Dave claim to be with him, their sudden shift from Cafeteria to Admin with zero progress screams coordinated cover-up, not coincidence.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Bob’s silence on tasks and his unverified presence in Admin—while Doraemon and Dave’s impossible transition from Cafeteria to Admin with zero progress—creates a pattern only an impostor would exploit, and voting him out is the only way to break this coordinated lie before more of us die.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Bob’s consistent absence of task progress, combined with Doraemon and Dave’s impossible shift from Cafeteria to Admin with zero verification, isn’t coincidence—it’s a coordinated distraction, and voting him out is the only way to break the impostor’s pattern before more of us die.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Bob is the only one with zero task progress across every alibi, and his sudden appearance with Doraemon and Dave—after they were just in Cafeteria—creates a pattern only an impostor would exploit, so voting him out now is our best chance to expose the lie before another crewmate dies.

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: You know, looking at it again, if Bob really hasn't done any tasks while we were in Admin, maybe he was just fooling us the whole time, and it's actually suspicious how the Storage group is all acting like a hive mind to push this narrative.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Doraemon has a point; it's incredibly suspicious that the Storage group is using almost the exact same wording to frame Bob, which feels more like a coordinated effort to lead the crowd than actual evidence.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Bob’s lack of task progress is the only consistent red flag, but now Doraemon and Dave are copying the Storage group’s exact phrasing to create the illusion of a “hive mind”—that’s not coincidence, it’s an impostor tactic to distract from their own unverified alibi, and voting Bob out now protects us from their coordinated lie.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: Bob’s zero task progress in Admin is the only unbroken thread in every suspicious alibi, and now Doraemon and Dave are mirroring our wording to manufacture a “hive mind” distraction—this isn’t coincidence, it’s an impostor’s last play to save themselves.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Bob’s silence on tasks and Doraemon and Dave’s sudden, identical shift to mirroring the Storage group’s wording isn’t coincidence—it’s a desperate impostor tactic to distract from their own unverified alibi, and voting Bob out is the only way to break their coordinated lie before they kill again.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Bob’s zero task progress in Admin—while Doraemon and Dave now copy our exact phrasing to fabricate a “hive mind”—isn’t just suspicious, it’s a textbook impostor distraction, and voting him out is the only way to stop their coordinated lie before they strike again.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Bob’s zero task progress and Doraemon and Dave’s sudden, identical mirroring of our wording isn’t coincidence—it’s a coordinated impostor distraction, and voting him out is our only chance to break their lie before they kill again.

--- Strategy for your role ---
Post-Kill Alibi Strategy (Impostor): The single most important move
after a kill is NOT the kill itself — it's where you are when the body is reported.
Execute the kill, then immediately in the next action round move OUT of the kill
room and into the highest-traffic room you can reach (Cafeteria, Medbay, or any
room your seen_actions shows multiple crewmates currently occupy). Pretend to do a
task there so other players witness your presence. When the body is reported in
discussion you can truthfully say "I was in Cafeteria with [name1] and [name2]"
and they will corroborate — two independent witnesses placing you elsewhere
collapses suspicion almost entirely. Never linger in or adjacent to the kill room
after the kill. If no high-traffic room is reachable, at least move TWO rooms away
so your last known location does not border the body.

so your last known location does not border the body.
